The olean check fails only because `Book1/Prop12/Main.olean` (a transitive import) isn't on disk — Book1/Prop12 has uncommitted source edits, and the runner appears to clean oleans between invocations (that olean existed when `wire_main` built green at 10:24). 

To get the authoritative olean-mode witness, I'll rebuild the real import closure via the sanctioned `wire_main` path (unwire → rewire, which rebuilds Book2.Prop12.Main and its Book1 dependency oleans) and run the faithfulness check in the **same** RUN block so the freshly-built oleans persist through the check.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
python3 scripts/wire_main.py Book2/Prop12 --unwire
python3 scripts/wire_main.py Book2/Prop12
scripts/check_faithful.sh Book2.Prop12.Main
<<<END>>>
